title: Java CompletableFuture Composition — Companion Resources

description: Runnable Java 17+ examples: thenCompose sequential pipelines, thenCombine/allOf parallel fan-out, anyOf replica racing, error handling with exceptionally/handle/whenComplete, custom executors, timeouts, and async retry with delayedExecutor backoff.
